Unit 1 review and future practice

Unit 1 · Week 16 · Lesson 4 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Open the exam-preparation chapter and its learning resources. Use paper or a local editor as appropriate, with fictional data and disposable practice copies. The suggested 55-minute lesson is flexible.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

1. Unit 1 review and future practice

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Explain the goal and the expected independent outcome. Explain key ideas and choose a realistic next step. This is ungraded textbook learning. Suggested times can be adjusted to the class. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

2. Retrieval and explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval, then partner comparison

Use short independent explanations. Accept traces, tests and requirement-based comparisons with clear assumptions. Allow silent thinking before discussion. Ask a learner to justify an answer before revealing the explanation. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

3. Evidence across the unit

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Worked table and teacher explanation

These examples support learning review. They do not certify complete syllabus coverage or predict a result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

4. A realistic next action

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and explain

A small specific action is easier to follow than revising everything. Use evidence from the earlier practice to choose it. Pause for predictions before discussing the expected result. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

5. Peer explanation

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided paired practice

Example: change a mask, a tie rule or a file mode. Check the learner notices which conclusion depends on that assumption. Swap explaining and checking roles so both learners articulate the reasoning. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

6. Independent practice

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent application with optional support

Use the textbook’s current practice questions. Any official examination instructions or school scheduling must come from the current authorised source, not this slide deck. Offer the relevant worked example if needed, then use a changed case to check independent understanding. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

7. A choice to explain

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Whole-class response and justification

A. Sampling gives limited evidence. Practical implementation, diagrams and later retrieval check different aspects. Give thinking time and collect reasons, without recording scores. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.

8. Exit explanation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual reflection and fresh explanation

End with concrete progress and a realistic plan. Weeks 17–18 remain the planner’s examination block, with no new textbook lessons added here. Use the response to select the next explanation or practice activity. Teaching reference: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/#exam-preparation. Use the current chapter and its linked resources.
